tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Claude documentation (the guides and the API reference together) by keyword. Put a phrase in double quotes to match it exactly (case is ignored). Returns matching pages and API endpoints ranked by relevance, with snippets showing context around matches.

tools.name: get_navigation
tools.description: Get the documentation navigation: tabs, groups of pages, and pages with their paths. Call it without arguments to see every tab and its groups, then pass `tab` and `group_path` to see the pages of a group. A group marked "(not expanded)" in the markdown, or without pages and groups in the structured

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Get the full content of a documentation page. Returns the page title, description, URL, and cleaned markdown content.

tools.name: get_api_endpoint
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific API endpoint including parameters, request body, and responses.
